.comparison-matrix {
  display: grid;

  grid-template-columns: minmax(235px, 0.72fr) repeat(3, minmax(275px, 1fr));
  min-width: 1100px;
}

  align-items: center;
  background: #e7eaed;
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: flex;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: 0.25rem;
  text-align: center;
}
.row-label {
  background: #f4f5f6;
  border-left: 4px solid #697582;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 0.55rem;
}
.row-label h3 { font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0 0 0.35rem; }
.details { font-size: 0.7rem; line-height: 1.35; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.image-cell { align-self: start; }
.image-cell figure, .diagnostics figure, .clean-comparison figure { margin: 0; }
.image-cell img, .diagnostics img, .clean-comparison img {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.missing {
  align-items: center;
  background: #f7eded;
  color: #842b2b;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 180px;
  padding: 1rem;
  text-align: center;
}
figcaption { color: #555; font-size: 0.68rem; margin-top: 0.12rem; text-align: center; }
.diagnostics { display: grid; gap: 0.8rem; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.clean-comparison {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.8rem;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}
.clean-cell { min-width: 0; }
.failure { color: #842b2b; }
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .diagnostics, .clean-comparison { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import html
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path.cwd()
manifest = json.loads((HERE / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def load_json(path):
    if not path:
        return {}
    try:
        return json.loads((HERE / path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return {}


def show(value, unit=""):
    if value is None or value == "":
        return "—"
    if isinstance(value, float):
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            return "—"
        value = f"{value:.6g}"
    return html.escape(f"{value} {unit}".strip())


def metrics_text(qa):
    metrics = qa.get("metrics", {}) or {}
    residual = metrics.get("residual", {}) or {}
    region = metrics.get("region", {}) or {}
    return "<br>".join(
        (
            f"clean peak: {show(metrics.get('clean_peak_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}",
            f"residual RMS: {show(residual.get('rms_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}",
            f"scaled MAD: {show(residual.get('scaled_mad_jy_per_beam'), 'Jy/beam')}",
            f"robust DR: {show(metrics.get('dynamic_range_scaled_mad'))}",
            f"metric radius: {show(region.get('min_radius_beams'))} to "
            f"{show(region.get('max_radius_beams'))} beams",
        )
    )


def image_cell(result_dir, filename, case_label, column_label, missing_reason=None):
    if not result_dir:
        reason = html.escape(missing_reason or "Result was not produced")
        return f'<div class="image-cell missing">{reason}</div>'
    source = html.escape(f"{str(result_dir).rstrip('/')}/{filename}", quote=True)
    alt = html.escape(f"0012-399 {case_label} {column_label}", quote=True)
    return (
        '<div class="image-cell"><figure>'
        f'<a href="{source}" target="_blank"><img src="{source}" alt="{alt}"></a>'
        f'<figcaption>0012-399 — {html.escape(column_label)}</figcaption>'
        '</figure></div>'
    )


def comparison_row(case_label, details, result_dir, missing_reason=None):
    cells = [
        '<div class="row-label">'
        f'<h3>{html.escape(case_label)}</h3>'
        f'<div class="details">{details}</div></div>'
    ]
    for filename, column_label in (
        ("dirty.png", "Dirty"),
        ("clean.png", "Clean"),
        ("residual.png", "Residual"),
    ):
        cells.append(
            image_cell(
                result_dir,
                filename,
                case_label,
                column_label,
                missing_reason=missing_reason,
            )
        )
    print("".join(cells))


def clean_comparison_cell(result_dir, case_label, missing_reason=None):
    if not result_dir:
        reason = html.escape(missing_reason or "Result was not produced")
        return f'<div class="clean-cell missing">{reason}</div>'
    source = html.escape(f"{str(result_dir).rstrip('/')}/clean.png", quote=True)
    label = html.escape(case_label)
    return (
        '<div class="clean-cell"><figure>'
        f'<a href="{source}" target="_blank">'
        f'<img src="{source}" alt="0012-399 {label} CLEAN image"></a>'
        f'<figcaption><strong>{label}</strong><br>0012-399 CLEAN image</figcaption>'
        '</figure></div>'
    )


title = html.escape(str(manifest.get("title", "Amplitude versus phase corruption")))
description = html.escape(str(manifest.get("description", "")))
source = manifest.get("source", {}) or {}
configuration = manifest.get("configuration", {}) or {}
variants = manifest.get("variants", []) or []
variant_by_name = {item.get("name"): item for item in variants}
failures = manifest.get("failures", []) or []
failure_by_name = {item.get("name"): item for item in failures}

print(f"<h1>{title}</h1>")
print(f"<p>{description}</p>")
print('<div class="summary">')
print(f"Dataset: <strong>0012-399</strong><br>")
print(f"Source thermal experiment: {show(source.get('thermal_experiment'))}<br>")
print(f"Source simulated MS: {show(source.get('simulation_ms'))}<br>")
print(
    f"Same selected antenna for both errors: {show(configuration.get('antenna_name'))} "
    f"(ID {show(configuration.get('antenna_id'))})<br>"
)
print(
    f"Significant diagnostic errors: amplitude gain="
    f"{show(configuration.get('amplitude_gain'))} (+50%); phase="
    f"{show(configuration.get('phase_error_degrees'), 'deg')}<br>"
)
print(
    f"Imaging: {show(configuration.get('imaging_configuration'))}, "
    f"imsize={show(configuration.get('imsize'))}; "
    f"weights={show(configuration.get('weight_policy'))}<br>"
)
print(f"Completed corrupted variants: {len(variants)} / 2; failures: {len(failures)}")
if failures:
    detail = "; ".join(
        f"{item.get('name', 'unknown')}: {item.get('error', 'unknown error')}"
        for item in failures
    )
    print(f'<div class="failure">{html.escape(detail)}</div>')
print("</div>")

print("<h2>0012-399 image comparison</h2>")
print(
    "<p>Exactly three rows show the same dataset; columns are the dirty, CLEAN, "
    "and residual images.</p>"
)
print('<div class="matrix-wrap"><div class="comparison-matrix">')
for heading in ("Dataset / case", "Dirty", "CLEAN", "Residual"):
    print(f'<div class="matrix-header">{heading}</div>')

baseline_dir = source.get("baseline_result_dir")
baseline_qa = load_json(Path(baseline_dir) / "qa.json") if baseline_dir else {}
comparison_row(
    "0012-399 — clean simulation with thermal noise",
    metrics_text(baseline_qa),
    baseline_dir,
)

for name, case_label in (
    ("constant_amplitude", "0012-399 — one-antenna constant amplitude-only error"),
    ("constant_phase", "0012-399 — one-antenna constant phase-only error"),
):
    variant = variant_by_name.get(name, {})
    failure = failure_by_name.get(name, {})
    qa = load_json(variant.get("qa_json"))
    details = (
        f"antenna: {show(variant.get('antenna_name', configuration.get('antenna_name')))} "
        f"(ID {show(variant.get('antenna_id', configuration.get('antenna_id')))})<br>"
        f"amplitude gain: {show(variant.get('amplitude_gain'))}<br>"
        f"phase: {show(variant.get('phase_error_degrees'), 'deg')}<br>"
        f"{metrics_text(qa)}"
    )
    comparison_row(
        case_label,
        details,
        variant.get("result_dir"),
        missing_reason=failure.get("error", "Variant has not completed"),
    )
print("</div></div>")

diagnostic_variants = [
    variant_by_name[name]
    for name in ("constant_amplitude", "constant_phase")
    if name in variant_by_name and variant_by_name[name].get("corruption_plot")
]
if diagnostic_variants:
    print("<h2>Applied gain diagnostics</h2>")
    print('<div class="diagnostics">')
    for variant in diagnostic_variants:
        plot = html.escape(str(variant["corruption_plot"]), quote=True)
        label = html.escape(str(variant.get("label", variant.get("name", "corruption"))))
        print(
            '<figure>'
            f'<a href="{plot}" target="_blank"><img src="{plot}" alt="{label}"></a>'
            f'<figcaption>{label}: gain function and gain-table samples</figcaption>'
            '</figure>'
        )
    print("</div>")

print("<h2>Final CLEAN-only comparison</h2>")
print(
    "<p>The three CLEAN images for 0012-399 are repeated side by side for direct "
    "comparison.</p>"
)
print('<div class="clean-comparison">')
print(clean_comparison_cell(baseline_dir, "Thermal simulation"))
for name, case_label in (
    ("constant_amplitude", "Amplitude error: one antenna, gain 1.50 (+50%)"),
    ("constant_phase", "Phase error: one antenna, +45 degrees"),
):
    variant = variant_by_name.get(name, {})
    failure = failure_by_name.get(name, {})
    print(
        clean_comparison_cell(
            variant.get("result_dir"),
            case_label,
            missing_reason=failure.get("error", "Variant has not completed"),
        )
    )
print("</div>")
```
